content: #1 Uniting the electroweak and strong interactions is known as Grand Unification. The challenge was to find a simple, elegant equation to unite the gauge coupling constants of the SU(2)xU(1) and SU(3). I managed to find such an equation (https://www.academia.edu/33966401/Grand_Unification_of_Gauge_Coupling_Constants) when I was trying to eliminate the Landau Pole. I also improved the accuracy of the measurments for the strong coupling and its running.
subject: Grand Unification of Gauge Coupling Constants

content: #2 There are not many people reading here who could give you feedback on this. You could try at PF the sub-forum “Beyond the standard model” (here), there are one or two good people reading there. But beware that everyone in the business is tired of people with crazy ideas in their drawers. If you want somebody to take a serious look, best not to just point to a pdf sitting somewhere, but to say in a few words what your idea is and what you’d like comments on.
subject: Grand Unification of Gauge Coupling Constants
